name: When is it necessary to call a professional for drywall damage?

mainEntity.name: When is it necessary to call a professional for drywall damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: It's necessary to call a professional for drywall damage when holes are larger than 4-6 inches, when there's significant water damage, structural concerns (like damage around electrical outlets or plumbing), or if you require a perfectly seamless finish. Professionals can accurately assess underlying issues, apply correct repair techniques, and ensure the repair meets industry standards, preventing future complications and enhancing your home's appearance and integrity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a professional for holes larger than 4-6 inches, water damage, structural concerns, or when a perfectly seamless finish is desired.
